lanes.short_description: Order from FOODEX retail and wholesale storefronts with account-aware ordering and delivery workflows.
lanes.full_description: FOODEX Customer provides authenticated retail and wholesale shopping, product discovery, cart and checkout, order tracking, notifications, account management, addresses, favorites and support surfaces backed by the production FOODEX service.
lanes.reviewer_notes: Use the Dashboard-managed Customer reviewer persona. Sign in, confirm the expected customer/store context, browse catalog, review account/settings and exercise the deletion-request entry without using production personal credentials.
lanes.release_notes_en: Store-submission readiness, legal/support surfaces, secure reviewer configuration, account deletion workflow and configurable version-footer visibility.
lanes.release_notes_ar: جاهزية الرفع للمتاجر وصفحات الدعم والسياسات وحساب المراجع الآمن وطلب حذف الحساب والتحكم في ظهور شريط الإصدار.

lanes.short_description: FOODEX operational Driver/Van app for assigned delivery workflows and live operational status.
lanes.full_description: FOODEX Driver/Van supports authenticated operational assignments, pickup and delivery execution, notifications, controlled active-delivery location reporting and diagnostics against the production FOODEX service.
lanes.reviewer_notes: Use the Dashboard-managed Driver/Van reviewer persona. Sign in to the assigned operational identity, verify assignment/context and exercise the deterministic review journey. Driver accounts use managed deactivation/retention rather than Customer self-deletion semantics.
lanes.release_notes_en: Store-submission readiness, secure reviewer configuration, release signing validation, permission declarations and configurable version-footer visibility.
lanes.release_notes_ar: جاهزية الرفع للمتاجر وإعداد المراجع الآمن والتحقق من توقيع الإصدار وتوثيق الصلاحيات والتحكم في ظهور شريط الإصدار.

lanes.short_description: FOODEX Van field operations for authenticated mobile sales, route execution and operational workflows.
lanes.full_description: FOODEX Van provides authenticated van operations, route and visit execution, mobile sales workflows, notifications, secure session access and operational diagnostics against the production FOODEX service.
lanes.reviewer_notes: Use the Dashboard-managed Van reviewer persona with an account authorized by van.login. Sign in, verify the assigned operational context and exercise the deterministic Van review journey without using production personal credentials.
